verifications.note:
Verified by its originating reviewer role (code-security-reviewer, session da744e37, T-DG7-REV-CS-RG2) on candidate sha256:33266ccd9ce4ec4475de745ebacfaafbd2f25870f8be966086f4a74578b7259c (source 152db5b51; repair T-DG7-DO-D11, commit 4f44cd707).

1. Code: tools/release/secret-scan.mjs replaces the S3 exemption /^[a-z0-9_.]+$/ with isI18nKey() (l.82-85). The rule needs lower-case words joined by '.'/'_', at least one separator, and each segment at most 20 characters and 3 digits. A bare lower-case or hex value now falls through to the entropy rule.

2. The round-1 reproduction, re-run on this candidate with freshly generated values (10-s3-secret-shapes-repro.log):
- case (a), POSTGRES_PASSWORD = openssl rand -hex 24: S3 hit, exit 1;
- case (c), OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET = 24 lower-case alphanumerics: S3 hit, exit 1;
- case (d), the mixed-case control: S3 hit, exit 1.
In round 1, (a) and (c) gave PASS, exit 0. Case (b), a 32-hex value, was not reported in that one draw because its entropy was 3.44, below the ADR-0063 threshold of 3.5. isI18nKey was false, so that is not the defect.

3. Over 5000 random values per shape (11-s3-exemption-rates.log), isI18nKey exempts 0.0% of hex16, hex24, hex32, lower24, upper-hex, base32 and base64 values. The remaining non-reports come from other rules: the ADR entropy threshold (hex16 18.7%, hex24 1.0%), the 64-hex checksum shape (hex32 100%, disclosed in SC-13) and the upper-case 'key NAME' rule. None of these is the i18n exemption this finding was about.

4. No false positive was added:
- payload scan PASS (3158 files, allowed 33) and docs/handover PASS (13-secret-scan-payload-handover.log);
- history scan PASS (36211 blobs, allowed 219, exit 0; 14-secret-scan-history.log);
- secret-scan.test.mjs 32/32, including the 7 F-DG7-1011 tests (15-secret-scan-service-list-tests.log).
That log's one failure is service-list.test.mjs failing to load (MODULE_NOT_FOUND) in my clone, which had no node_modules. It was re-run with the repository's node_modules linked: 7/7 (15b-service-list-test.log).

5. Nothing is hidden today: a probe without the 64-hex and key-NAME exemptions finds only six environment-variable names and the T-G1 64-hex fixture in the payload (12-secret-scan-probe-no64hex-nokeyname.log, 12b-probe-hits-explained.log).

The ADR text was not amended. That residual is raised separately as F-DG7-1041 (Low).

Verified by its originating reviewer role (code-security-reviewer, session da744e37) on candidate sha256:33266ccd (source 152db5b51; repair T-DG7-DO-D11).

1. The round-1 probe, re-run on a disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 (with-pg.sh, port 32460): backup.sh --phase database under umask 022 with MTH_TRANSFER_ATTACHMENTS=none (16-backup-set-mode-repro.log).
- Every entry is now 0700 (directories) or 0600 (files): the root, the set, .backup-state/*, config/*, db/database.dump and db/table-counts.tsv. In round 1 they were 0755/0644.
- Nothing is readable or writable by group or others.
- The dump still holds TABLE DATA app_user, audit_event and session, so the protection matters.

2. New root checks:
- a 1777 root (the host /tmp shape) is refused with exit 2 and the BLOCKED line, and 0 entries are written;
- a symlinked root is also refused. That is fail-closed, but the message 'writable by group or others' is misleading, because find reads the symlink's own mode. Recorded as an observation in the review record, not a defect.
- A 0700 root owned by another uid could not be tested: chown is not permitted in the sandbox. Statically, the script checks the root's mode but not its owner. Recorded as a hardening observation.

3. Test suite: backup-restore.test.mjs 13/13, including T-E10 (owner-only set), T-E11 (the Compose sequence: database phase, copy-out under umask 022, finish) and T-E12 x2 (1777 and 0770 roots refused) (17-backup-restore-tests.log, exit 0).

4. Compose:
- docker compose v5.6.1 `config` (parse and validate only, no daemon), with MTH_BACKUP_ROOT unset, renders the backup bind as source /MTH_BACKUP_ROOT-is-not-set, target /backups, bind.create_host_path false. With it set, it renders source /srv/mth-backups. The default profile still renders db, migrate, api and worker (18-compose-config-backup.log).
- service-list.test.mjs F-DG7-1012 static test passes (15b-service-list-test.log).
- Residual, not run: Docker's runtime refusal of the missing host path and the root `backup` container's modes need a Docker daemon, which this sandbox lacks (the container half is the orchestrator's, D-267). backup-restore.md §10 discloses it. The script behaviour that produces the modes is the same script the container runs.

5. backup-restore.md §3.3 documents the root's permissions.
